parsed.internal_thinking: I have 2 Wood and 1 Ore. I need Brick, Sheep, and Wheat to build a settlement at N31. Claude has 2 Wood, 2 Wheat, and 2 Sheep. Gemma has 1 Sheep and 2 Wheat. I have a Monopoly card. If I use it now on Wheat or Sheep, I might get enough to build or at least trade. However, looking at the board, no one is producing much Brick yet (Hex 10 rolled 3 turns ago, but I don't see much in hands). Claude is the biggest threat with 6 cards. I'll propose a trade to Claude first to see if I can get Brick or Sheep for my excess Wood before using the Monopoly card or ending turn. Wait, looking at the resources, neither Claude nor Gemma have Brick in their public counts (Claude: 2S, 2Wh, 2W; Gemma: 1S, 2Wh). I'll try to trade Wood for Sheep with Claude to save my Monopoly for later when more resources are in play.
parsed.note_to_self: Holding Monopoly. Target N31 for Brick/Wheat/Wood. Claude has Sheep and Wheat. Gemma has Sheep and Wheat. Current hand: 2 Wood, 1 Ore.
